notes.title: Beta v1.1
notes.content:
[b][u][h1]Update Beta v1.1[/h1][/u][/b]

[u][h2]Added[/h2][/u]

- Game startup screen displaying the developer

- A New Achievement:

[list]
[*] "Bouncing off the walls"
[/list]-  [i]Complete a level while continuously jumping[/i]

- Remake of level creating screen (Currently takes a screenshot for temporary thumbnails, will be changed soon)

- Button to access the free roam area of Cúubville, a sort of test area if you will

- Official Steam Input controller layout (Currently only tested on Xbox controllers)

- Steam Deck mode (Detects if you are on steam deck and displays a message) - Currently has no effect.

- Proper feedback form for submitting bugs etc (The paper icon on the top right of the main menu screen)


[b][u][h1]Fixed[/h1][/u][/b]

- All objects in editor rotating when rotating one clock-wise

- The playing levels page exiting into the Workshop Hub

- Completing levels giving you multiple points towards achievements instead of one
